newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINES SMART FORMS JV WITH NIPPON.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINES SMART FORMS JV WITH NIPPON.

text.p: Smart Communications Inc has formed a joint venture with Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp to provide internet services in the Philippines, a senior officer of Smart said on Monday.
The new firm, NTT Multimedia Services, will also provide data transmission services in the local market, he said.
The new company has an initial capital of 250 million pesos.
NTT also has equity in Smart, a local cellular phone provider.
Other stockholders of Smart are First Pacific Co Ltd and its Philippine flagship Metro Pacific Corp.
